bio: Slaley Hall is a stunning 4-star hotel housed inside a beautiful Edwardian mansion and set within 1000 acres of picturesque countryside in Hexham, Northumberland.  Enjoy a sumptuous Afternoon Tea in plush surroundings. You will be treated to an array of delicious savouries and sweet treats all washed down with a reviving hot drink. If you're in an extra indulgent mood, why not add a glass of champagne?!
